title: Wrong generic argument count

sourceOfTruth.rule: Use the compiler-required arity and decompiled generic type declaration from the installed DLL.
authoritativeInputs: decompiled generic class or interface declaration

symptoms: Using the generic type requires more type arguments.
A service, interface, base class, or DI registration still uses the previous arity.
investigation: Read required generic argument count from the compiler error.
Load the symbol route for known Core 8 generic changes.
Search all class declarations, interfaces, base clauses, DI registrations, and call sites for the old arity.
patchRules: Add the missing type arguments at the exact positions shown by the decompiled declaration.
Update interface, implementation, base class, and DI registration together.
Use types that satisfy the decompiled generic constraints.
antiPatterns: Do not use DTO types when the constraint requires model types.
Do not update only the class declaration and leave DI on the old arity.
Do not infer arity from a stale diff when the installed DLL disagrees.

successCriteria: The CS0305 family for the symbol reaches zero.
Any resulting CS0311 constraint errors are handled using the CS0311 route.
